description: Search the BroFindAI directory of 750+ AI tools by keyword, category, pricing, platform, tags, API availability, or open-source status. Returns matching tools with full structured metadata.

api.description: true = only tools with a confirmed public API; false = only tools confirmed to have none. Tools where this is unknown are excluded either way.

category.description: Filter by category: 'Writing & Content', 'Coding & Dev Tools', 'Image Generation', 'Chatbots & Assistants', 'SEO & Marketing', 'Video', 'Audio & Voice', 'Business', 'Research', 'Data & Analytics', 'Other'

opensource.description: true = only confirmed open-source tools; false = only confirmed proprietary. Tools where this is unknown are excluded either way.

platform.description: Only tools available on this platform

query.description: Search keyword (matches name, tagline, description, and tags)

tags.description: Only tools carrying ALL of these tags (e.g. ['coding','autocomplete']). Call list_tags for the vocabulary.

name: search_ai_tools
